what: Build, Cache and Query dbSNP VCF Data as Parquet
title: Build, Cache and Query dbSNP VCF Data as Parquet
text: Build, cache, query dbSNP VCF data Parquet. dbSNP4Bioc converts single chromosome NCBI dbSNP VCF (distributed: bgzipped tabix-indexed) slim, sorted Parquet representation, caches locally BiocFileCache, exposes cached resource lazy dplyr/dbplyr table backed duckdb, rsID genomic-position lookups can written ordinary dplyr::filter() / dplyr::select() pipelines.

title: Build, Cache and Query dbSNP VCF Data as Parquet
text: Point DBSNP_GCF_PATH NCBI’s bgzipped, tabix-indexed dbSNP VCF (.gz.tbi index must sit next ):

title: Build, Cache and Query dbSNP VCF Data as Parquet
text: extracts chromosome 17 tabix, keeps SNV records (REF every ALT single /C/G/T; one row per ALT allele), writes two Parquet tables cache: by_pos (sorted position) by_rsid (sorted rsID).
code: library(dbSNP4Bioc)  dbsnp_build_chrom("17", release = "b157", build = "GRCh38") dbsnp_cached("b157", "GRCh38")   # see what is cached

title: Build, Cache and Query dbSNP VCF Data as Parquet
text: convenience wrapper also provided position-range lookups:
code: library(dplyr)  chr17 <- dbsnp_tbl("by_pos", chrom = "17", release = "b157", build = "GRCh38")  chr17 |>   filter(pos >= 38077296, pos <= 38083854, n_alt == 1) |>   select(pos, rs, ref, alt) |>   collect()  dbsnp_disconnect(chr17) dbsnp_in_range("17", 38077296, 38083854, biallelic_only = TRUE,                release = "b157", build = "GRCh38")

title: Build, Cache and Query dbSNP VCF Data as Parquet

title: dbSNP4Bioc: build, cache, and query dbSNP VCF data as Parquet — dbSNP4Bioc-package

what: Convert one dbSNP chromosome to Parquet and cache it — dbsnp_build_chrom
title: Convert one dbSNP chromosome to Parquet and cache it — dbsnp_build_chrom
text: Extracts single chromosome dbSNP VCF named dbsnp_gcf_path() (vcf argument), keeps SNV records , writes two sorted Parquet tables (by_pos, by_rsid), stores plus updated manifest.json BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache() cache. Later calls dbsnp_tbl() read straight cache.

title: Convert one dbSNP chromosome to Parquet and cache it — dbsnp_build_chrom
code: dbsnp_build_chrom(   chrom,   release = "b157",   build = "GRCh38",   vcf = dbsnp_gcf_path(),   cache = dbsnp_cache(),   tabix = "tabix",   rg_pos = 122880L,   rg_rsid = 16384L,   threads = NULL,   memory_limit = NULL,   tmpdir = tempfile("dbsnp4bioc_build_") )

title: Convert one dbSNP chromosome to Parquet and cache it — dbsnp_build_chrom
text: chrom Chromosome build: "1"-"22", "X", "Y". release dbSNP release label, used namespace cache (e.g. "b157"). build Genome build label, used namespace cache (e.g. "GRCh38"). vcf Path bgzipped, tabix-indexed dbSNP VCF. Defaults dbsnp_gcf_path(), .e. DBSNP_GCF_PATH environment variable. cache BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache() object; defaults dbsnp_cache(). tabix Name path tabix executable. rg_pos, rg_rsid Parquet row-group sizes by_pos by_rsid tables; smaller row groups let zone maps prune . threads, memory_limit Optional duckdb SET threads / SET memory_limit values. tmpdir Scratch directory intermediate TSV Parquet files copied cache.

title: Convert one dbSNP chromosome to Parquet and cache it — dbsnp_build_chrom
text: Invisibly, data frame columns chrom, table, path describing newly cached files (returned dbsnp_cached()).

what: Look up rsIDs by genomic position — dbsnp_in_range
title: Look up rsIDs by genomic position — dbsnp_in_range
text: dplyr-based convenience wrapper dbsnp_tbl(): filters by_pos table one chromosome position range. exact-position lookups across many positions, prefer building dplyr::semi_join() dbsnp_tbl() directly.

title: Look up rsIDs by genomic position — dbsnp_in_range
code: dbsnp_in_range(   chrom,   start,   end,   biallelic_only = FALSE,   release = "b157",   build = "GRCh38",   cache = dbsnp_cache() )

title: Look up rsIDs by genomic position — dbsnp_in_range
text: chrom single chromosome (e.g. "17"). start, end 1-based inclusive position range. biallelic_only TRUE, keep records single ALT allele (n_alt == 1). release dbSNP release label used caching (e.g. "b157"). build Genome build label used caching (e.g. "GRCh38"). cache BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache() object; defaults dbsnp_cache().

title: Look up rsIDs by genomic position — dbsnp_in_range
text: tibble columns chrom, pos, rs, ref, alt, n_alt.

what: A tidyverse-compatible view onto the cached dbSNP Parquet files — dbsnp_tbl
title: A tidyverse-compatible view onto the cached dbSNP Parquet files — dbsnp_tbl
text: Returns lazy dplyr/dbplyr table backed duckdb connection reading Parquet files dbsnp_build_chrom() cached, ordinary dplyr::filter(), dplyr::select(), dplyr::mutate(), dplyr::arrange(), dplyr::collect() calls work directly cache. Nothing read memory collect() (another action, print() pull()) called: duckdb pushes translated SQL predicate Parquet scan.

title: A tidyverse-compatible view onto the cached dbSNP Parquet files — dbsnp_tbl
code: dbsnp_tbl(   table = c("by_pos", "by_rsid"),   chrom = NULL,   release = "b157",   build = "GRCh38",   cache = dbsnp_cache(),   con = NULL )

title: A tidyverse-compatible view onto the cached dbSNP Parquet files — dbsnp_tbl
text: table sort order read: "by_pos" (sorted position; best range queries) "by_rsid" (sorted rsID; best rsID lookups). chrom Optional chromosome, vector chromosomes, restrict (e.g. "17"). Defaults every cached chromosome given table. release dbSNP release label used caching (e.g. "b157"). build Genome build label used caching (e.g. "GRCh38"). cache BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache() object; defaults dbsnp_cache(). con existing duckdb DBI::dbConnect() connection reuse; defaults opening fresh -process duckdb connection. Close dbsnp_disconnect() done (let garbage-collected).

title: A tidyverse-compatible view onto the cached dbSNP Parquet files — dbsnp_tbl
text: tbl_duckdb_connection / tbl_sql object: lazy dplyr table columns chrom, pos, rs, ref, alt, n_alt.
